info.title: ValidKit - IBAN, VAT, Card, ISBN, BIC & Postcode Validator
info.description:
# ValidKit: IBAN, VAT, Card, ISBN, BIC and Postcode Validator

Instant, offline validation for the identifiers that break checkout, invoicing and KYC forms: IBAN, EU VAT, payment card (Luhn and brand), ISBN, BIC/SWIFT, EAN/GTIN and postcodes. Each call returns `valid` plus a normalised value, so you can both reject typos and store clean data.

**Who it's for:** fintech and payments teams, B2B invoicing and e-commerce checkouts, marketplaces, bookshops and anyone building forms that collect bank, tax or product identifiers.

## Use cases
- Catch IBAN typos before a payout fails and costs a return fee.
- Check a B2B customer's EU VAT number format before applying reverse charge.
- Give instant card-number feedback and brand icons in checkout without touching your PSP.
- Convert ISBN-10 to ISBN-13 when importing a book catalogue.
- Validate and normalise postcodes in address forms for 24 countries.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://validkit-iban-vat-card-isbn-bic-postcode-validator.p.rapidapi.com/iban?value=GB82WEST12345698765432' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: validkit-iban-vat-card-isbn-bic-postcode-validator.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`validkit-iban-vat-card-isbn-bic-postcode-validator.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- All checks are algorithmic (format, length and checksum). Nothing is looked up live: a valid IBAN or VAT number is well-formed, not proven to exist.
- Invalid values return HTTP 200 with `valid: false`; HTTP errors are reserved for missing parameters.
- Card numbers are processed in memory, never stored, and only a masked form is returned.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `422` missing or invalid parameter. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Validation algorithms from python-stdnum (LGPL 2.1+).
- Card brand prefixes and postcode formats are maintained in-house from public specifications.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Checks country-specific length and structure and the ISO 7064 mod-97 checksum for IBANs from every IBAN country, and returns the compact and printed formats. Invalid values return 200 with `valid: false` and a `reason`, so you can show inline form errors.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: IBAN, with or without spaces. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

get.summary: Validate an EU VAT number format
get.description: Validates the format and check digits of an EU VAT identification number for all 27 member states plus XI (Northern Ireland). This is an offline check: it does not query VIES for current registration. Invalid values return 200 with `valid: false` and a `reason`, so you can show inline form errors.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: VAT number including its 2-letter country prefix, e.g. DE136695976 or FR40303265045. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

example.note: Checksum/format validation; not a live VIES registration lookup.

get.summary: Check a card number (Luhn and brand)
get.description: Strips spaces and dashes, runs the Luhn checksum and detects the brand (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, Diners, JCB, UnionPay, Maestro). Returns only a masked number. Use it for instant form feedback; it does not contact any card network, so it cannot tell whether a card is active.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Card number (PAN). Spaces and dashes are allowed. Use test numbers in development. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

get.description: Validates ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 check digits, converts to ISBN-13 and returns the hyphenated form. Invalid values return 200 with `valid: false` and a `reason`, so you can show inline form errors.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, hyphens optional. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

get.description: Checks the structure of an 8 or 11 character BIC (institution, country, location and optional branch code). Invalid values return 200 with `valid: false` and a `reason`, so you can show inline form errors.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: BIC/SWIFT code, 8 or 11 characters. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

get.description: Validates the check digit of EAN-8, UPC-A (12 digits), EAN-13 and GTIN-14 numbers. Invalid values return 200 with `valid: false` and a `reason`, so you can show inline form errors.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: EAN/GTIN digits (8, 12, 13 or 14). Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

get.summary: Validate a postcode format by country
get.description: Checks a postal code against the official format for 24 countries and normalises it (GB gets the standard space). This is a format check, not an address-database lookup.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Postal code, any case. Max 64 characters; surrounding whitespace is ignored.

example.error: country must be one of AT, AU, BE, BR, CA, CH, DE, DK, ES, FR, GB, IE, IN, IT, JP, MX, NL, NO, NZ, PL, PT, SE, US, ZA
